ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio between dominant high-intensity white central regions (approx. 80% surface area) and low-intensity black perimeter and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes are contiguous white; heavy black pigmentation mapping along the trailing and leading edges; distinct clusters of circular black mottle-patterns (rosettes) distributed across the mid-interior of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along the trailing edge with irregular pixel-amplitude peaks, particularly pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edge transitioning to slightly tapered, dark-pigmented fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular black clusters (potential barnacle attachment sites) concentrated in the lower-mid quadrants of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct dark linear pixel disruption (rake mark) extending diagonally across the lower right lobe; several smaller horizontal linear marks visible on the left lobe near the leading edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rosette scarring and at least one prominent diagonal linear rake mark on the right ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy, solid black pigmentation at the distal tips of the flukes, contrasting sharply with the white interior.
